study.name: Phase 3c: H9 Diversity — Track 1 (Image)
study.description:
Tests whether introducing diversity across consensus voting passes
improves detection accuracy compared to identical passes (H9).

Uses Scale-8 composition (17 examples: 4 Canon+, 4 HP, 2 Canon-,
4 HN, 3 null) for all conditions. The Track 1 baseline (library_plus-hp)
had 0 HN; core HN (11-14) are added here for fair cross-condition
comparison — the HN rotation in Conditions C and E requires all
conditions to start from the same example count.

All conditions use HIGH thinking level. Temperature is fixed at T=0.7
(Phase 3a optimum) except where varied as the diversity dimension.
